In promptfoo, you can re-run only the tests that errored, rather than the whole suite, using the eval ID from the previous run:

```powershell
# Re-run only errored tests from the most recent eval
promptfoo eval --filter-errors-only latest

# Or from a specific eval ID
promptfoo eval --filter-errors-only <evalId>
```

The `--filter-errors-only` flag selects tests that ended in an error, such as network failures or rate-limit responses, and skips the ones that passed or failed normally. Your config and prompts stay the same, so run it from the same directory as your original `promptfoo eval` command.

I also believe a `promptfoo retry` command exists for this purpose, but I'm less certain of its exact syntax in your version. Run `promptfoo --help` and `promptfoo eval --help` to confirm which options your installed version supports. If your run was interrupted rather than finishing with errors, `promptfoo eval --resume <evalId>` is the related option to check for.
